name: W Koh Samui
insider_take: This ultra-modern beachfront sanctuary redefines luxury on Thailand's second-largest island, where ancient Buddhist temples meet cutting-edge design.
whats_special: W Koh Samui sits on secluded Maenam Beach, featuring infinity pools that seemingly blend into the Gulf of Thailand. The hotel's signature WOOBAR offers panoramic sunset views over the mystical Ang Thong Marine Park's 42 pristine islands. Each villa boasts private pools and direct beach access, while the award-winning AWAY Spa incorporates traditional Thai healing with contemporary wellness treatments.
pro_tip: Book the Extreme WOW Ocean Haven villa for the ultimate experience – it features a 15-meter infinity pool and comes with a dedicated beach butler and speedboat transfers.
dont_miss: Take a sunset cocktail cruise to Ang Thong National Marine Park, explore the famous Big Buddha Temple just 10 minutes away, or experience the hotel's exclusive "W Sound Suite" – a recording studio where guests can create their own music with professional equipment.
pros: Stunning beachfront location with pristine white sand beach access
Contemporary luxury design with vibrant W Hotels signature style
Multiple world-class dining venues and beach bars
Extensive spa and wellness facilities with tropical treatments
cons: Remote island location requires flight connections
